messages:
leah: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1 - observed a route-flap domino that triggered TLS handshake jitter and a retry amplification index spike. Keeping this thread tight: owners, ETAs, short notes only.

Top actions (owner / ETA):
1) controller linearize + idempotency: enforce canonical apply order and add write guards to avoid transient dual-paths (owner: omar) - ETA: 2026-04-08
2) handshake damping: implement per-peer in-flight handshake cap + capped jittered backoff, expose runtime override (owner: ravi) - ETA: 2026-03-31
3) registrar cooldowns: registrar-aware backoff + token-bucket for reconcile attempts (owner: gina) - ETA: 2026-03-30
4) probe + dashboard: synthetic 'amplification-index' probe + alert (owner: leah) - ETA: 2026-03-28
5) short-run mitigation: feature flag prefer-local-failover + canary playbook (owner: leah) - ETA: 2026-03-26
6) runbook + comms: emergency playbook + internal ops checklist + customer advisory draft (owner: product@redwood) - ETA: 2026-04-04

omar: ack. i'll add a linearization layer to the reconciler and mark applies with an operation id to make replays idempotent. plan a migration job to reapply stale entries.

ravi: ack. plan: default cap=8 concurrent handshakes per-peer, backoff base=40ms factor=2 full-jitter cap=1.2s. will add runtime flags and a per-tenant override.

gina: ack. will add per-registrar cooldown table and token-bucket rate limiter for reconcile loops. default cooldowns conservative; add cloud-specific tuning.

leah: probe sketch - POST /internal/probe/amplification-index
```
{ "pair": "us-west-2:eu-central-1", "concurrency": 25, "rounds": 500 }
```
Alert if amplification_index > 1.7 or p95 retries > 3. will wire into datadog and add dashboard /dashboards/net-amplification.

omar: q: do we scope linearize change to controller only or include announcer ordering? prefer controller-only first.

ravi: agree controller-first. announcer ordering risk too big. if controller-only doesn't reduce index, we'll escalate.

leah: mitigation: for the next 48h enable feature/prefer-local-failover when amplification_index > 1% for 2 consecutive minutes. gated and canary to one region.

oncall-bot: Created followup ticket NET-6201 assigned to leah, omar, ravi, gina. First sync scheduled 2026-03-29 14:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary started: tag=linearize-reconciler.v1 region=us-west-2 start_ts=2945678985. Monitor: /dashboards/net-amplification-canary.

omar: pushed draft PR https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4120 - linearize + idempotency markers. requesting review from @ravi @gina.

ravi: reviewing now. will add client change reference and a perf microbenchmark to ensure no tail-latency regressions.

gina: will prepare registrar testbed workload and inject 429 patterns for probe validation. need infra perms for test runner.

leah: infra, please grant gina testbed access ASAP. also ill own runbook and coordinate SRE review.

omar: minor note: we'll add a debug mode to log apply diffs for 24h post-canary to help debug any leftover dual-edges.

ravi: i'll prepare client library patch and compat note so passthrough customers are aware of default caps.

leah: thanks all. update this thread with PR links, dashboard links, or if ETAs slip. if you can't meet ETA, ping me and we'll reassign. :thumbsup:
